- 10m current workflow / objectives from Skymoon
- 10m MAP walkthrough (milestones & owners)
- 10m technical readiness & data access checklist
- 10m next steps + decision points (procurement, SLA)

Suggested slots next week: Tue 10–11am PT, Wed 1–2pm PT, Thu 9–9:45am PT — which works for you?

- mutual_blueprint_template (Google Doc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_mutual_blueprint_draft

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Eli — perfect, locking Wed 1–2pm PT. I added two short sections to the doc in advance: pricing bands (pilot: dev/test, small pilot, production estimation) and an owner column for procurement items. See the "budget & procurement" tab in the tracker.

High-level pilot timeline we typically see (we'll adapt during workshop):
- Week 0: Kickoff, data access provisioning, Q&A (this meeting + action items)
- Week 1–2: Integration & sample tests (SDK + test dataset)
- Week 3–4: Model tuning + evals using selected prompt/traffic slice
- Week 5: Acceptance tests & performance validation (latency/cost targets)
- Week 6: Executive demo + go/no-go decision; contract amendment if going to production

We expect an internal review of the security questionnaire in 3–5 business days if you can provide the SOC2 & cloud architecture diagram; otherwise we can start a lightweight security intake first for the pilot.

Attaching updated deck (v1.1) and pushing the doc link again: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_mutual_blueprint_draft?usp=sharing

Action items for Wed: please have an engineering owner join (for data access) and procurement on for the first 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Jordan

All good — I can cover the SDK versions slide and will bring the sample ingestion script. For ingestion we generally need:
- A minimally scoped service account/key with read-only access to a sample bucket (or an SFTP endpoint)
- A sample dataset (<= 1000 docs) with labels if available (helps evals)
- Expected traffic pattern (tokens/min) for sizing batching/latency profiles

I'll be on Wed 1–2pm PT and can stay for the tech Q&A.

—Dev
